reason: Factor each q^N - 1 into cyclotomic polynomials. Then the Phi_t-exponent in F_{b,m,d}(q) is the difference between the numbers of multiples of t in the intervals {b+d+1,...,b+d+m} and {b+1,...,b+m}, which gives the stated floor formula. The rational function is a polynomial exactly when all these exponents are nonnegative; then it is a finite product of cyclotomic polynomials and hence lies in Z[q].
